verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a memory feature where Copilot can store facts users ask it to remember and use them to personalize future responses and suggestions, plus controls to view/delete memory (copilot-docs-32, copilot-docs-33, copilot-docs-38). However there is no dedicated 'custom instructions' setting described (unlike explicit persona/tone controls), and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming these stored facts consistently shape *every* response. Missing for 10: explicit custom-instructions UI documentation, hands-on confirmation that memory reliably influences all responses, and community corroboration of the feature's effectiveness.
